title: Secret rooms under shops
content: Last night I recall a vivid Mallworld dream. I was in what seemed to be a fancy soap shop. In the dream, asked the workers where the restroom was. I seemed to have unlocked a stairway down into a "secret" part if the shop, like a smaller room that had some exotic items in fancy shelf displays, and a sense of immense quiet. I think there were actually restroom doors down there as well, but i didn't fully see that. What is odd is that it felt familiar like I had stumbled across this extra room before. As an experiment, other dreamers should try and ask the ship keepers in random Mallworld shops if they "could use the restroom", maybe that is somehow code for unlocking secret passages or rooms in the Mallworld. 🤔
